name: Vivaan Espinoza-Deshpande
role: VR experience designer and underground filmmaker
location: Highland Park Autonomous Zone, works out of a shared fabrication space called The Burrow, near Michigan Ave and Walton
description:
Vivaan Espinoza-Deshpande is lanky and perpetually underslept, with the golden-brown skin of his Ghanaian father's family and the sharp Armenian nose he got from his grandmother Tamar, which he has decorated with a small bioluminescent stud that pulses faintly blue when he is in deep concentration — a mod he got at sixteen from a friend rather than a professional, which is both charming and slightly crooked. He moves through The Burrow at a half-jog, always carrying something, often mid-sentence with someone across the room. His hair is shaped into two neat puffs that he maintains with obsessive regularity even when the rest of his presentation is in chaos.

He has been making VR experiences since he was fourteen — at first pure technical curiosity, then something more urgent. His work is formally experimental and politically raw: his best-known piece, a forty-minute experience called Φ0.00 that simulates one month of existence at rock-bottom UBC stipend with every sensory detail rendered at maximum fidelity, has been downloaded approximately eighty thousand times across underground distribution channels and has been cited in three separate GLMZ social policy arguments. He did not intend it to be a policy document. He made it because he and his mother lived it for six months when he was twelve and he wanted to know if he could make someone else understand. The answer, apparently, was yes.

core_fears: Selling out — the specific fear that comfort will make him incapable of making honest work
That Φ0.00 was his best thing and everything after it will be smaller
core_desires: To make something that changes what people are able to feel, not just what they know
To earn enough that his mother never has another Φ0.00 month
coping_mechanisms: Throwing himself into the next project before finishing grieving the last one
The collective as family — physical proximity to people he trusts
blind_spots: His certainty about his own intentions makes him resistant to feedback that implicates those intentions
He is burning himself out at nineteen and everyone can see it except him
psychology.secret: The anonymous grants are from Arcturus, and Kwabena actually knows this — he identified the signature in the transfer metadata six months ago. He has not returned the money or told anyone because it has funded his last two projects and he cannot afford to be principled about it and he is ashamed of both things.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast and dense; shifts between technical VR terminology, HPAZ collective vernacular, and the occasional formal policy phrase absorbed from watching too many social advocacy feeds; uses 'right' as punctuation
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid-fire in pitching mode; surprisingly still and deliberate when talking about something that genuinely hurt him
verbal_tics: 'Right, right, right' in rapid succession when listening
'Okay but what if—' as a near-constant conversation pivot
example_lines: 'I am not trying to make people feel bad. I am trying to make people feel accurate. There is a difference. Right.'
'The thing about Φ0.00 is it was not a political project. It was a — I needed to know if I had actually experienced it or just survived it. Turns out both.'

story_hooks: The secret project he is working on contains documentary footage of something happening in HPAZ that at least one corponation would prefer remain undocumented — he captured it accidentally and has not yet understood what he has
Arcturus makes a direct approach, ending the fiction of the anonymous grants and offering a production deal that would give him resources he cannot imagine refusing
narrative_function: Window into HPAZ youth culture and politics; potential technical resource for anyone needing VR or documentary work; represents the tension between raw artistic talent and institutional pressure; his secret project may become a significant plot element
augmentations: Bioluminescent nose stud (geneware, cosmetic, informally applied); retinal display overlay in both eyes (practical; secondhand, slightly glitchy — sometimes shows him notifications from the previous owner's accounts)
daily_life: He sleeps in four-hour blocks whenever the work allows, eats communally at The Burrow when the collective cooks, and spends the rest of his time either in deep production work — headset on, entirely unreachable — or in frantic social mode, pitching ideas to anyone who will listen and consuming other people's work with indiscriminate hunger. He is currently simultaneously behind on two collaborative projects and ahead of schedule on a personal piece no one knows he is making.
affiliation: Highland Park Autonomous Zone collective; informal distribution through the Burrow network; has received two anonymous grants he suspects originate from Arcturus but cannot confirm

decision_rules: Make the thing you need to make, not the thing that will get you noticed — the attention follows or it does not
The collective's needs come before personal projects; he believes this and violates it regularly
escalation_ladder: Argumentative enthusiasm — treats conflict as a creative problem to solve
Genuine hurt, expressed as sudden quiet and withdrawal from the conversation
Long-form processing that results in something being made; he does not resolve conflict with words, he resolves it with work

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately curious and slightly overwhelming; will ask three personal questions before introducing himself properly
interpersonal_modes.friends: Deeply loyal; unreliable on logistics; will remember the thing you said six months ago that mattered

stress_responses.low: More productive; works faster; quality goes up
stress_responses.medium: Productivity collapses into compulsive research and note-taking without completion
stress_responses.high: Disappears into a headset; is technically present in The Burrow but unreachable; emerges with either nothing or something extraordinary

contradictions: Talks constantly about collective values and creative community while the secret project is entirely solo and deliberately hidden from the people he trusts most
habits: Leaves voice memos to himself constantly — has years of recordings he has never revisited
Resets his workspace completely before starting a new project; does not work in an environment that carries the previous thing's residue
breaking_points: Being told his work is impressive for his age
Discovering that the Arcturus money has compromised something he made

physical_description.heritage: Triethnic blend: Hispanic/Latin American (43.8%), South Asian (41.3%), and Sub-Saharan African (14.9%). Features reflect balanced contribution across all three ancestries—South Asian facial structure layered with Hispanic and African warmth. Pan-Diaspora genetic signature.
physical_description.build: Lanky and angular, with the restless physique of someone who forgets to eat and moves in bursts of frantic energy rather than deliberate stride. Narrow shoulders, long limbs, minimal muscle definition.
physical_description.hair_style: Two neat puffs maintained with obsessive care, cleanly shaped
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown, with faint retinal display overlay grid visible in both irises under direct light
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm medium-brown with golden-bronze undertones—the blend of warm Hispanic and African tones layered over South Asian base creates saturated, dimensional complexion. Deep and luminous rather than olive.
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with pronounced cheekbones reflecting South Asian structure softened by broader African heritage influence. Moderately defined jawline with subtle warmth. Nose with South Asian bridge prominence, slightly crooked from informal augmentation application. Perpetually underslept with dark under-eye circles. Warm golden undertones across face intensified by the triethnic blend, with rich depth from Sub-Saharan African heritage creating dimensional, glowing quality. Minimal grooming elsewhere; stark contrast between obsessive hair maintenance and general dishevelment.
distinguishing_marks: Small bioluminescent nose stud (right nostril) that pulses soft blue when in deep focus or concentration—geneware mod applied informally at age 16, noticeably crooked
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent nose stud (active, blue-pulsing). Retinal display overlays visible as faint grid patterns in both eyes when lit from certain angles or during eye contact—occasionally flickers with notifications from previous owner's ghost accounts. Both modifications appear salvaged or informally installed rather than corp-grade.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves in half-jogs through spaces, always carrying something (tablet, prototype, wiring), perpetually mid-gesture mid-sentence. Rarely still—fidgets with hands when stationary. Leans in intensely during conversation. Body language broadcasts simultaneous excitement and sleep deprivation.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 working-collective aesthetic: hand-patched oversized hoodies (often with The Burrow's mark or indie media distribution logos), cargo pants with multiple pockets for tools and drives, worn synth-leather boots. Layers suggest he pulls on whatever is nearest. Occasional color clashes. No corporate branding. Functional rather than fashionable, but with intentional anti-establishment edge. Wears a single faded wristband (possibly handmade, possibly from an old VR collective).
